summary: All 4 P0 bugs verified as FIXED. Backend API tests (12/12 passed). UI testing confirmed all fixes working correctly.

bug_1_logo_preview.details: Logo upload and preview working for both Super Admin (OrganizationManagement) and Admin (OrganizationDetails). Public /api/files/{id}/view endpoint correctly serves image files without authentication for img tags. Non-image files rejected with 403.

bug_2_evidence_download.details: Evidence file download working with authentication at /api/files/{id}. Unicode filename handling fixed (was throwing encoding error). Download requires auth, view endpoint for images is public.

bug_3_version_history.details: Version history now shows user email (e.g., admin@ghg.com) instead of 'Unknown User'. Backend populates changed_by_email field by looking up user from changed_by ID. UI displays email with user icon.

bug_4_remarks_saving.details: Remarks/Notes field saves and persists correctly for both Organizations (via Super Admin API) and Facilities (via Admin API). Field visible in view mode and editable in edit mode.

seed_data_creation: None - used existing test data, created one history entry by updating emission
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 P0 bugs have been fixed and verified. Logo preview uses /view endpoint for public access. Evidence download uses /files/{id} with auth. Version history correctly shows changed_by_email. Remarks field saves correctly.

bug_1_logo_preview.root_cause: Logo URLs needed public access for img tags which don't send auth headers
bug_1_logo_preview.fix: Added /api/files/{id}/view public endpoint for image files only

bug_2_evidence_download.root_cause: Unicode characters in filenames caused encoding error in Content-Disposition header
bug_2_evidence_download.fix: Sanitize filename to ASCII-safe characters before setting header

bug_3_version_history.root_cause: changed_by_email field was not being populated in history response
bug_3_version_history.fix: Backend now looks up user email from users collection using changed_by ID and populates changed_by_email

bug_4_remarks_saving.root_cause: Remarks field was already working - just needed verification
bug_4_remarks_saving.fix: No fix needed - confirmed working via API and UI tests
